text:
## Escalation Matrix  
**Complaint Escalation by Severity & Involvement:**  
| Level | Authority | Timeline | Complaints |
|-------|-----------|----------|-----------|
| **Frontline** | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value |
| **Manager** | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss |
| **Director** | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, >£500 loss |
| **Escalated** | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, reputational risk |  
**Escalation Triggers:**
- Complaint unresolved after manager review
- Financial compensation >£500
- Regulatory or reputational concern
- Media/legal involvement
- Customer escalates to FCA

raw_entities.name: Complaint Escalation Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the escalation of customer complaints through defined authority levels based on severity, financial impact, and involvement triggers. The policy establishes timelines and decision-makers at each escalation stage, from frontline customer service through to CEO/Board level.
context: Escalation Triggers: Complaint unresolved after manager review, Financial compensation >£500, Regulatory or reputational concern, Media/legal involvement, Customer escalates to FCA

raw_entities.name: Frontline Complaint Resolution Requirement
raw_entities.description: Customer Service Agents must resolve simple, low-value complaints at frontline level within one day.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

raw_entities.name: Manager-Level Complaint Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Complaints Managers must review and resolve moderate issues with financial loss under £500 within five days.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

raw_entities.name: Director-Level Complaint Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Head of Customer Service must review significant issues with financial loss exceeding £500 within eight days.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, >£500 loss

raw_entities.name: CEO/Board Escalation Requirement
raw_entities.description: Major failures with reputational risk must be escalated to CEO/Board level with resolution timelines of 8 or more weeks.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, reputational risk

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Unresolved After Manager Review
raw_entities.description: Complaints must be escalated if they remain unresolved after manager review.

raw_entities.description: Complaints requiring financial compensation exceeding £500 must be escalated to director level or above.

raw_entities.description: Complaints involving regulatory or reputational concerns must be escalated to senior management or board level.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Media or Legal Involvement
raw_entities.description: Complaints involving media or legal involvement must be escalated to CEO/Board level.

raw_entities.description: Complaints escalated by customers to the FCA must be escalated to CEO/Board level.
